component.name: Brokey
component.summary: One store for every way a Linux machine gets software

description.p: Brokey searches the distribution's own repositories, the AUR, Flatpak remotes, the Snap Store and GitHub releases from one box, and shows the same application from several sources as one row with a choice of how to install it. Icons, descriptions and screenshots come from AppStream and Flathub.

One Updates page checks every source, updates everything or a selection, and says when a selection would be a partial upgrade on Arch. Drivers install through chwd on CachyOS and firmware through fwupd. Brokey checks for its own new versions and installs them the way this copy was installed.
This is an early release. Notable limits:

ul.li: pacman and the AUR are tested on a real machine. apt and dnf are written to the same interface and are marked untested until they have run on Debian and Fedora.
Reviews and ratings are not shown.
